## Import Dataset

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
student_risk <- read_csv("student_dropout_risk_2026.csv")
is.tibble(student_risk)
```

## EDA

```{r}
View(student_risk)
student_risk |> 
  summarize(
    across(
      where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm=TRUE)
  )
```
